user.title: PalPulse for Home Assistant
user.description: Enter the Powerpal BLE MAC address. The ESPHome node must emit PalPulse timestamped record events.

error.invalid_mac: Enter a valid six-byte MAC address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

abort.already_configured: This Powerpal meter is already configured.

init.title: Electricity pricing and legacy costs
init.description: Home Assistant manages prices by default, with no PalPulse-generated cost statistic. To use custom tariffs with external PalPulse energy statistics, choose Flat or Time of Use. Only select a historical cost source if it has cumulative Recorder sums; current $/kWh sensors are not historical costs.

data_description.legacy_cost_statistic_id: For a separate, backup-first import of previously recorded costs. Example: sensor.electricity_cost_today, only if it has valid long-term cumulative cost sums.

flat.title: Flat electricity tariff
flat.description: Enter actual GST-inclusive rates from your bill in cents. Daily supply is charged once per local calendar day and may be set to 0 when cost tracking is usage-only.

time_of_use.title: Time of use / free power
time_of_use.description: Use actual plan rates. For Red Power5: free 11:00-16:00 on both weekdays and weekends, cap 15 kWh/day, and paid-excess rate from your bill. Other Red Energy offers may use different hours or caps. Clock windows use local time, comma-separated HH:MM-HH:MM, and may not cross midnight. Empty free/peak/shoulder windows are allowed. Supply defaults to zero; check your bill.

data_description.daily_free_cap_kwh: For Red Power5, enter 15; for Red Midday Power Saver, 24
data_description.free_excess_cents_per_kwh: Red Power5 previously used 16.412 c/kWh in your local configuration. Verify current bill before use.

error.invalid_pricing: Invalid rate, free allowance or tariff window. Check for overlapping peak/shoulder periods.
error.invalid_source: Specify a sensor.* or external statistic ID, or leave blank.
